Which should you buy?

  • Longest blackout runtime: EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3 — 4,096 Wh runs a 150 W fridge for approximately 23 hours, versus approximately 20 hours.
  • Bigger appliances: EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3 — 4000W (Surge 8000W) AC output, against 3600W (Surge 7200W).
  • Lower budget: EcoFlow DELTA Pro at KES 291,399, KES 170,400 less than the EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3.
  • Best value per watt-hour: EcoFlow DELTA Pro at about KES 81 per Wh of storage.
  • Easiest to carry: EcoFlow DELTA Pro at 45kg.
